A terminal UI library for PHP, built bottom-up from one primitive: a Surface
that is a terminal emulator. Everything that shows on screen is a Surface; a
shell in a pty and a PHP coroutine that echoes are the same kind of producer,
writing the same bytes into it.

        Tabs    and   spaces,   wide 中文 characters, and accents: café, naïve.

  1. Surface
  2. Producers
  3. Viewport
  4. Screen
  5. Layout
  6. Component
